outline: This course will be given in English and it surveys the principal concepts of fluid dynamics. Topics include mass and momentum conservation, the Navier-Stokes equation for viscous flows, as well as dimensional analysis. Emphasis is placed on being able to utilize the concepts to solve the real problems encountered during conducting research
schedule:
Course Syllabus
1-2 weeks: Introduction to Momentum Transport
3-4 weeks: Shell Momentum Balance
5-8 weeks: Vectors and Tensors
9-10 weeks: Reynold’s transport theorem and the kinematics of fluid motion
11-12 weeks: Case study
13-14 week: Stress in fluids
15 week: Viscosity and the Momentum transport
16 weeks:Equation of Motion: Navier-Stokes Equation
17 week: Final Exam
18 week: Discussion
